snippet.title: BOMBSHELL BLITZ 💣 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Inspired by the simplicity and challenge of the classic Wii Play 'Tanks!' minigame, BOMBSHELL BLITZ takes the twin-stick tank shooter premise to the next level with its own action roguelite twists and cute character cast to spice things up!

WISHLIST BOMBSHELL BLITZ:
💣 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445610/BOMBSHELL_BLITZ
